reportSubtitle: Two Demos Booked, One From the New Creative
summary: Two demos booked this week, one from the new One Workspace ad and one that looks direct. I am reading the ad driven booking as an early signal, not a verdict. One call on a partial week does not settle the creative test, so the priority now is a clean full week and a clearer read on which angle is actually pulling, so we can put real budget behind the winning direction instead of spreading it across four concepts. Detail below.

metrics.label: Ad Spend
metrics.note: Down from $293.40 last week; the new creatives launched late and are still ramping delivery.

metrics.label: Demos Booked
metrics.note: One came from the new One Workspace ad, one was a direct visit.

metrics.label: Cost per Demo
metrics.note: Blended across both bookings; the ad driven demo alone came in near $127, still efficient for a $999/mo product.

data.note: One Workspace took most of the budget and the clicks. Replaces Competitors posted the strongest click through rate.

findings.title: The Blocker Has Shifted From Lead Quality to Getting Demos
findings.description: The new qualifier modal is operating as intended, only allowing teams of 3+ to even book a demo. Let me know if the quality is better as you meet with them.

findings.title: The Ad Driven Demo Came From the New Creative
findings.description: The one ad driven booking came from the new One Workspace creative. Not getting too excited on just on booking yet, but we'll continue monitoring into next week to see how the creative performs.

findings.title: B2C Signups Are Happening on Their Own
findings.description: Seven solo or small team visitors routed to pricing this week, and five went on to start a self serve signup on their own, four of them from the new ads. No nurture and no follow up, just the funnel filtering as designed.

actions.title: Launched Four New Static Creative Concepts
actions.description: One Workspace, Replaces Competitors, Outdated, and In Sync went live as four distinct messaging angles to test what resonates.

actions.title: Moved Booking Into the Funnel
actions.description: Integrated cal.com directly into the funnel so booking now happens in place, instead of sending people out to a separate booking page. This improves the booking process for users.

nextSteps: Run the four creatives for a full uninterrupted week to see which angle consistently pulls.
Once a clear winner emerges, put production budget behind a quality video in that direction rather than spreading across four static concepts.
Watch whether moving booking into the funnel lifts the rate at which form submissions turn into booked demos.
